zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Each zone is one physical switch entity (a relay channel, valve, or smart plug) and how long it runs for. Leave a zone empty if you don't have it. Name your zones so programs are easy to read later.

programs.title: Programs (timers)
programs.description: Each program is an independent timer: a start time, the days it fires, and which zones it switches on. Configure as many as you need, up to 4. Leave a program's zones empty to leave it unused.
